title: Tom Clancy's The Division: Extremis Malis
summary: A licensed three-issue Division 2 prequel graphic novel that follows Agent Caleb Dunne from New York to Philadelphia and Washington as a Black Tusk-linked arms operation surfaces.

claims.text: Dark Horse's collected edition identifies Extremis Malis as the three-issue graphic-novel prequel to Tom Clancy's The Division 2.
The official edition's published premise follows Division Agent Caleb Dunne as he pursues the woman responsible for his partner's death from New York toward Washington, D.C.

paragraphs.text: Extremis Malis is official Division transmedia: a three-issue Dark Horse graphic novel positioned as a prequel to The Division 2 rather than a game mission or player-capture source.
Its source-specific route follows Caleb Dunne after a fatal New York encounter, through Philadelphia and toward Washington, while exposing an arms operation connected to the coming Black Tusk threat.

verification.notes: Licensed-comic record. Public text is an original summary only; the archive publishes neither comic dialogue nor visual material.
